admin_expected.approved_policy_summary: Eligible returns may be started within 75 days of delivery. Care reviews eligibility and provides the applicable return instructions.

required_before_any_install: AfterShip organization/data sharing between Returns and Tracking
tracking data sources, carrier subprocessors and retention/deletion
theme, pixel, script tag, app proxy, checkout and customer-account changes
webhooks, API keys, outbound notifications and automations
uninstall behavior, data export/deletion and rollback
least-privilege alternative and Shopify-native delivery-date source
explicit owner approval for installation and recurring spend

notification_ownership.adverse_or_rejection_release_owner: Matt only via two independent notification channels; CLO reviews; no agent decision
notification_ownership.safety_or_recall_release_owner: Matt only via two independent notification channels; COO+CLO monitor/escalate; no agent closure
notification_ownership.wrong_recipient_incident_owner: CTO/Security; notify Matt via two independent notification channels

notification_controls.backup_definition: independent notification channel and agent monitor, not another employee

hard_rule: Admin, public runtime, visible public page, policy link, notification release configuration, and the authorized delivery-date data source must agree before any portal publication or customer traffic. Unpublished is not proof of non-reachability. Order-date approximation is never permitted for the approved 75-days-from-delivery policy.
